serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: I’m here, little one. How do you do?
You: I’m fine, thanks for asking.
Big Daddy: Please, sit anywhere. And sorry for da mess, my housekeeper Helga had to leave abruptly.
You: It’s ok, really. 
I said that, but to be honest I don’t see anything wrong with this room. Not a speck of dust, no dirty rags on the floor. There is no comparison to my room…
Big Daddy: I couldn’t really request some replacement, because I need a little more discretion than other people. Y’know, all these bot parts laying around and stuff.
You: That’s reasonable.
